summary: Repair manifest lock target-set integrity and adopt Wellmanifest new-project 0.20.33 in two sequential atomic updater transactions

delivery.outcome: The adoption lock's managed target set equals the package manifest's managed strategies with drift-free digests, and Koru runs the published wellmanifest/new-project 0.20.33 projection with matching packaging pins and verified S0-S4 evidence receipts.
nonGoals: No source, test or behaviour change in Koru itself beyond the standard-managed projection
No release and no registry publish
No changes to tickets other than ticket-172 tracking carriers

architecture.decision: Repair slice: run the immutable create_adoption_lock.py updater at the currently pinned b6ba9c21 (0.20.32) with --upgrade so the drifted managed wellmanifest_governance.py is restored and the lock is regenerated, dropping ticket-154's hand-added .governance/manifest.json pin and hand-pinned drifted digest; the lock change rides with a managed package target change so the protected Validator's package-advisory atomicity contract accepts the transaction. Adoption slice (second PR after the repair merges, because the governance atomic adoption proof validates the Git base lock target set): rerun the updater at a8245857 (0.20.33), realign package.json and pyproject.toml [tool.wellmanifest] pins, and refresh standard-adoption/evidence receipts with upstream CI run 35451961370 and ruleset 20451097. The pytest --collect-only skip hand-patched by ticket-154 returns through the upstream 0.20.33 projection (wellmanifest/new-project ticket-248). Standard-managed payload files beyond this ticket's declared instance paths are owned by the updater transaction and verified through the atomic adoption proof, not by these component lists.
dataChanges: Adopted standard advances from 0.20.32 to 0.20.33 after the repair restores the 0.20.32 projection
Adoption lock target set repaired to equal managed strategies with drift-free digests
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commits; the managed payload, lock and both packaging pins return to the pre-repair 0.20.32 state (including ticket-154's local collect-only patch).

validation.evidence: Governance gate passes; lock target set equals the package manifest managed strategies and digests match the working tree.
Updater drift check (pinned standard checkout) reports up-to-date for the pinned 0.20.32 revision.
Manifest instance files and lock bind published 0.20.33 at a8245857259d8d42115108f191c586b76cb1e2bd (adoption slice).
Updater drift check (pinned standard checkout) reports up-to-date for 0.20.33 (adoption slice).
S0-S4 evidence validates with upstream CI run 35451961370 and ruleset 20451097 receipts (adoption slice).
package.json and pyproject.toml [tool.wellmanifest] reference 0.20.33 and a8245857259d8d42115108f191c586b76cb1e2bd (adoption slice).
Managed governance gate and whitespace checks pass on both slices.
